re_line: RE: Trump-Xi-Putin Shenzhen Trilateral · Nvidia Halts H200 Shipments · Russian Jets Trigger Taiwan ADIZ, Japan Scrambles
morning_memo: Xi Jinping personally greeted Donald Trump at Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport on Nov 18, the first time Xi has received a foreign leader on the tarmac in his 13-plus years in power, ahead of a trilateral summit with Vladimir Putin.

Nvidia's interim CEO confirmed the company has stopped shipping H200 AI chips to China despite US government approval; MOFA spokesperson Guo Jiakun said China has 'repeatedly clarified its principled position' on the matter when asked about it at the Nov 18 briefing.

Taiwan's MND detected Russian aircraft exiting its ADIZ south of Taitung County on Nov 17, the same day Japan lodged a 'strong protest' with Moscow over an airspace violation off Fukuoka, both ahead of Putin's arrival in Shenzhen.

key_stat.label: PBOC overnight reverse repo operation, Nov 18
key_stat.context: The operation, on the final day of this month's tax-payment window, held the rate at 1.25% and produced a net liquidity withdrawal of about CNY13.8 billion versus maturing repos, per analysts cited by Phoenix Finance.
key_stat.source: 凤凰网财经 (Phoenix Finance), via PBOC tracker

prc_government.action: Conducts CNY700.2bn overnight reverse repo, holds rate at 1.25%
prc_government.detail: The Nov 18 operation fell on the final day of this month's tax-payment window; a slightly larger maturity left a net withdrawal of about CNY13.8 billion, described by analysts as a passive adjustment rather than active tightening.

prc_government.action: Confirms outcomes of China-Canada trade consultations
prc_government.detail: The spokesperson addressed the results of China-Canada economic and trade consultations the same day Canada and China announced an expanded trade pact with deeper tariff cuts, per the WSJ.

prc_government.action: Responds to new US Commerce curbs on remote access to advanced semiconductors
prc_government.detail: The spokesperson fielded questions on the US Commerce Department's newly announced measures restricting remote access to advanced semiconductors, amid Beijing's broader warning it would retaliate against new AI chip restrictions.

prc_government.action: Urges Taiwan to lift curbs on mainland students after enrollment drops by half
prc_government.detail: Responding to Taiwan's release of this year's mainland-student enrollment data showing roughly a 50 percent drop from last year, TAO said Taiwan should remove 'unreasonable restrictions' on mainland students applying to study there.

calendar_watch.headline: APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting concludes in Shenzhen
calendar_watch.detail: Trump, Xi and Putin are holding a trilateral summit alongside the APEC Leaders' Meeting Nov 18-19; Trump's trip began in Manila.

calendar_watch.headline: PBOC monthly LPR decision
calendar_watch.detail: The loan prime rate is set on the 20th of each month, following the Nov 18 reverse repo operation that held the policy rate at 1.25%.

calendar_watch.headline: Taiwan nine-in-one local elections
calendar_watch.detail: 22 mayors and magistrates and roughly 11,000 offices are up for election; Sinocism reports China 'barely factors' into voter decisions, with housing and employment dominating.

calendar_watch.headline: Nanjing Massacre National Memorial Day
calendar_watch.detail: China's annual national commemoration (国家公祭日) falls roughly three weeks after the Shenzhen APEC summit.

calendar_watch.headline: G20 Leaders' Summit opens in Doral, Miami
calendar_watch.detail: The US hosts the G20 Dec 14-15; Xi's attendance has not been confirmed.

overnight_items.headline: CNN Analysis: US Curbs Won't Stop China's Tech Rise, Xi Showcases Shenzhen
overnight_items.body_text: Xi is using the Shenzhen summit to showcase China's technological rise despite years of US export controls, CNN reported Nov 17. The analysis argues Washington's restrictions have not slowed Beijing's tech ambitions.

overnight_items.headline: Shenzhen Empties Out, Ramps Up Surveillance Ahead of APEC
overnight_items.body_text: Shenzhen has undertaken elaborate preparations, from landscaping to extensive surveillance, ahead of the APEC summit, the NYT reported Nov 18. The city appeared half-empty as authorities cleared space for the gathering.

overnight_items.headline: Chinese Robots Learn From Humans in Tech Hub Shenzhen
overnight_items.body_text: Robots in Shenzhen are being trained to learn tasks by observing humans, AFP reported Nov 18, coinciding with the city's turn in the global spotlight for APEC.

overnight_items.headline: China Censors CNN's Live Coverage of Nvidia Spy-Scandal Report
overnight_items.body_text: CNN's live feed was cut in China when its report on the investigation into Alice Huang's suspected ties to China's spy agency aired, CNN said Nov 17. Beijing denies the claims underlying the probe.

overnight_items.headline: Sinocism: Local Issues, Not China, Drive Taiwan Voter Choice
overnight_items.body_text: China 'barely factors' into Taiwanese voters' decisions ahead of the Nov 28 local elections, with housing, employment and public safety driving choices, per Tim Culpan's guest post.

overnight_items.headline: AP: Tech Snafus Dog Trump's Asia Trip Even as He Seeks to Project Strength
overnight_items.body_text: Trump sought to project strength during his China stop, but a series of technological glitches on the trip raised concerns back home, AP reported Nov 18.

overnight_items.headline: WaPo: Trump Arrives in Shenzhen, a City Tied to Xi's Family History
overnight_items.body_text: Trump arrived in Shenzhen, a city with deep ties to Xi's family history, the Washington Post reported Nov 18, ahead of the trilateral with Putin.

us_china.headline: China Warns of Retaliation If US Imposes New AI Chip Curbs
us_china.body_text: Beijing warned Washington it would retaliate if the US imposes new AI chip export restrictions, Bloomberg reported Nov 17, while urging continued dialogue. The warning landed a day before Trump and Xi met in Shenzhen.

us_china.headline: Trump Administration Weighs Forcing US Firms to Disclose Chinese AI Use
us_china.body_text: The Trump administration is considering a rule requiring US companies to disclose their use of Chinese AI technology, Reuters reported Nov 18, citing sources. The proposal would add to a widening set of AI-related restrictions.

us_china.headline: China Data Center Curb Advances Despite Big Tech Lobbying
us_china.body_text: A rule restricting China-linked data centers is advancing despite lobbying from Amazon, Google and Meta, Reuters reported Nov 17. It would require Southeast Asian data centers to seek US approval before buying advanced AI chips.

us_china.headline: Banks Pause $480 Million Chip Loan Tied to ByteDance
us_china.body_text: Banks paused a *$480 million* loan tied to chip purchases linked to **ByteDance**, Bloomberg reported Nov 17, amid a broader clampdown on loopholes used to finance Chinese AI chip purchases.

us_china.headline: US Lawmakers Press Mercedes-Benz on Chinese Ties
us_china.body_text: US lawmakers asked Mercedes-Benz to disclose details of its ties to China, Reuters reported Nov 17. The request adds the German automaker to a growing list of firms facing congressional scrutiny over China links.

us_china.headline: Prosecutors Cast Huawei as 'Villain' in Trade Secrets Trial Closings
us_china.body_text: US prosecutors described **Huawei** as a villain in closing arguments of its trade secrets trial, AP reported Nov 17, while the company's lawyer disputed the characterization.

us_china.headline: Trump Pushes AI Cooperation With Quad Leaders Before Xi Meeting
us_china.body_text: Trump held talks on AI cooperation with Quad leaders from Japan, Australia and India ahead of meeting Xi, Bloomberg reported Nov 17. The consultation was timed immediately before the Shenzhen trilateral.

us_china.headline: WSJ: US Enters Three-Way Nuclear Rivalry With China, Russia
us_china.body_text: The US has entered an unprecedented three-way nuclear rivalry with China and Russia, the WSJ reported Nov 18, as Trump, Xi and Putin convene together for the first time.

china_world.headline: Taiwan Says It Is in 'Close Contact' With US Ahead of APEC Trilateral
china_world.body_text: Taiwan's APEC envoy said he would be in close contact with the US and speak with other members at the China-hosted summit, Reuters reported Nov 18. Taipei is monitoring the trilateral for any cross-strait implications.

china_world.headline: Xi, Putin Blast Western 'Protectionism' and Sanctions as Trump Lands in China
china_world.body_text: **Xi Jinping** called for open trade and **Vladimir Putin** condemned sanctions in APEC opening remarks, Reuters reported Nov 18, hours before Trump's arrival in Shenzhen. Both leaders spoke to the APEC CEO Summit ahead of the trilateral.

china_world.headline: Europe Watches Nervously as Trump, Xi, Putin Meet Behind Closed Doors
china_world.body_text: European officials expressed concern over what Trump, Xi and Putin might discuss privately in Shenzhen, CNN reported Nov 18, noting the three control the large majority of the world's nuclear arsenal. No agenda for the private talks has been disclosed.

china_world.headline: Defense Minister Dong Jun Makes Surprise Visit to Italy
china_world.body_text: **Dong Jun** made a surprise visit to Rome, the first by a Chinese defense minister in 18 years, the FT reported Nov 17. The trip comes as strains grow between Beijing and the EU.

china_world.headline: Tata Steel CEO: Chinese Steel Imports Remain Threat to Indian Industry
china_world.body_text: Chinese steel imports remain a threat to India's domestic industry, Tata Steel's CEO said, per Reuters Nov 18. The comment follows continued calls from Indian industry for stronger trade protections.

china_world.headline: Kremlin Says Putin Open to Meeting Kim Jong Un in China
china_world.body_text: **Vladimir Putin** could meet **Kim Jong-un** if the North Korean leader travels to Shenzhen for APEC, the Kremlin said, per the NYT Nov 17. North Korea has not confirmed whether Kim will attend.

china_world.headline: Xi, South Korea's Lee Hold Third Summit in Shenzhen
china_world.body_text: **Lee Jae-myung** met Xi in Shenzhen on Nov 18 for their third summit, after meetings in Gyeongju last November and Beijing in January, Yonhap's Chinese service reported. The *34-minute* talks covered trade and investment cooperation.

china_world.headline: Mexico's Sheinbaum Offers 'New Era' of Ties With China
china_world.body_text: **Claudia Sheinbaum** offered a 'new era' of Mexico-China relations after a prior trade spat, Bloomberg reported Nov 17. Trump separately plans to meet Sheinbaum during his stop in China.

china_world.headline: New US AI Chip Rules Rattle Southeast Asia's Data Center Boom
china_world.body_text: New US restrictions could jeopardize billions in Southeast Asian data-center investment built on Chinese demand, the NYT reported Nov 17. Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand now face a harder balance between Washington and Beijing.

top_stories.headline: Xi Greets Trump at Shenzhen Airport in Unprecedented Gesture Ahead of Trilateral
top_stories.body: **Xi Jinping** personally received **Donald Trump** at Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport on Nov 18, the first time Xi has greeted a foreign leader on the tarmac in more than a decade in power, the NYT reported. Trump arrived for the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting and a three-way summit with Russian President Vladimir Putin, capping a 48-hour swing through Asia that began in Manila.

top_stories.headline: Russian Aircraft Enter Taiwan ADIZ, Japanese Airspace as Putin Heads to Shenzhen
top_stories.body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said two Russian military aircraft flew off the island's east coast and exited its ADIZ south of Taitung County on Nov 17. Japan lodged a 'strong protest' with Moscow after two suspected Russian aircraft violated its airspace off Okinoshima, Fukuoka, the same day, prompting JASDF fighter scrambles, Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara said.
top_stories.src_line: Taipei Times, citing Taiwan MND and Japan's Chief Cabinet Secretary

top_stories.headline: Nvidia Halts H200 AI Chip Shipments to China Despite US Approval
top_stories.body: **Nvidia**'s interim CEO said the company has stopped shipping H200 AI chips to China even though Washington had approved the exports, Reuters reported Nov 18. MOFA spokesperson Guo Jiakun said China has 'repeatedly clarified its principled position' on US chip sales to China when asked about the halt.

top_stories.headline: Democratic Senator Introduces Bill to End China's Trade Status Ahead of Trump-Xi Meeting
top_stories.body: A Democratic senator introduced a bill to end China's permanent normal trade relations status on Nov 17, timed to Trump's arrival in Shenzhen for the Xi summit, Reuters reported. The move came the same week House members separately pressed Mercedes-Benz to disclose its Chinese ties.

top_stories.headline: China's Central Bank Signals Restraint on Further Easing as Growth Holds Up
top_stories.body: The PBOC signaled limited appetite for further monetary easing as recent growth data held up, the WSJ reported Nov 18. The signal follows the PBOC's Nov 18 overnight reverse repo of *CNY700.2 billion* at an unchanged 1.25% rate, conducted on the final day of this month's tax-payment window.

also_today.headline: Rockstar Promotes GTA VI in China Without Sales Approval
also_today.body_text: Rockstar is promoting GTA VI in China despite lacking official sales approval, Reuters reported Nov 18.

also_today.headline: Vestas CEO Calls for Tougher EU Rules on Chinese Wind Software
also_today.body_text: Vestas's chief executive called for tougher EU rules on Chinese software used in wind turbines, Reuters reported Nov 17.

also_today.headline: Brazil Contests EU Review of Anglo American Nickel Mine Sale to China's MMG
also_today.body_text: Brazil is contesting an EU review of Anglo American's sale of a nickel mine to China's MMG, Reuters reported Nov 17.

also_today.headline: Three Things to Watch as Trump, Xi, Putin Meet in Shenzhen
also_today.body_text: CNBC outlined three dynamics to watch as Trump, Xi and Putin convene alongside the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen.

also_today.headline: PNG's Marape Tells Xi Closing Taiwan Office 'Wasn't Easy'
also_today.body_text: Papua New Guinea's PM James Marape told Xi closing Taiwan's office in PNG 'wasn't easy' amid domestic challenges, Taipei Times reported Nov 18.

also_today.headline: KMT Denies Circulating 10-Year Unification Plan Is Party Policy
also_today.body_text: Taiwan's KMT denied a circulating 10-year 'peaceful unification' proposal represents party policy, Taipei Times reported Nov 18.

also_today.headline: NYT: Spy Scandal, Trade Friction Cloud Xi's APEC Moment
also_today.body_text: Xi faces export worries, a spy scandal and an unpredictable Trump floating a Kim Jong-un meeting at his Shenzhen summit, NYT reported Nov 17.

also_today.headline: Asics Aims to More Than Double China Stores
also_today.body_text: Asics plans to more than double its store count in China as part of an expanded market push, Bloomberg reported Nov 18.

also_today.headline: Peru's Fujimori Appeals to Xi for Help Against El Niño
also_today.body_text: Peru's president Fujimori appealed to Xi for Chinese assistance ahead of an anticipated El Niño event, Bloomberg reported Nov 17.

also_today.headline: US Raids Factory Making Illegal Chinese Vapes
also_today.body_text: US authorities raided a factory producing illegal Chinese-origin vapes, Reuters reported Nov 17 in an exclusive.

business_economy.headline: Canada, China Expand Trade Pact, Cutting Tariffs Further
business_economy.body_text: Canada and China agreed to cut tariffs further under an expanded trade pact, the WSJ reported Nov 18, as Ottawa diversifies from reliance on the US.

business_economy.headline: BHP, Rio Tinto Executives to Meet China Leaders Amid Iron Ore Pressure
business_economy.body_text: Executives from BHP and Rio Tinto are set to meet Chinese leaders as pressure builds in the iron ore market, Reuters reported Nov 18.

business_economy.headline: China Gas Doubles Volume in 20-Year LNG Deal With Venture Global
business_economy.body_text: China Gas doubled the contracted volume in its 20-year LNG supply deal with Venture Global, Reuters reported Nov 18.

business_economy.headline: Jetour Reaches Deal to Produce Vehicles in Brazil
business_economy.body_text: China's Jetour reached a deal to produce vehicles in Brazil, according to sources cited by Reuters Nov 17.

business_economy.headline: China Bank Stock Rally Gains Momentum as Global AI Trade Unravels
business_economy.body_text: Chinese bank stocks extended a rally as the global AI trade unwound elsewhere, Bloomberg reported Nov 17.

business_economy.headline: JD.com Shares Fall Despite In-Line Third-Quarter Results
business_economy.body_text: JD.com shares fell even after third-quarter results came in roughly in line with estimates, Reuters reported Nov 17, with weak consumer demand cited.

business_economy.headline: Hongqi Evaluates VW, Stellantis as Partners to Build Cars in Europe
business_economy.body_text: China's Hongqi is evaluating partners including Volkswagen and Stellantis to build cars in Europe, Reuters reported Nov 17.

official_line.speaker: TAO spokesperson
official_line.topic: Taiwan status amid US-China-Russia trilateral summit
official_line.statement: Per TAO: the Taiwan question is purely China's internal affair, unrelated to the Trump-Xi-Putin talks in Shenzhen.
official_line.original_zh: 台湾问题纯属中国内政
official_line.context: A reporter asked whether the trilateral summit between Trump, Xi and Putin in Shenzhen would touch on Taiwan.

official_line.speaker: Guo Jiakun
official_line.topic: Nvidia halting H200 chip shipments to China
official_line.statement: Per MOFA: China has repeatedly clarified its principled position on the issue of US chips being exported to China.
official_line.original_zh: 中方此前已经多次阐明在美国输华芯片问题上的原则立场
official_line.context: An AFP reporter asked Guo Jiakun at the Nov 18 briefing about Nvidia's interim CEO saying the company would no longer supply H200 chips to China.

official_line.speaker: MOFA spokesperson
official_line.topic: Agenda for Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral summit in Shenzhen
official_line.statement: Per MOFA: the Chinese, Russian and American heads of state will have in-depth exchanges of views on important issues concerning global peace.
official_line.original_zh: 中俴美三国元首将就事关全球和平的重要问题深入交换意见
official_line.context: MOFA addressed the scope of the trilateral summit ahead of Trump's Nov 18 arrival in Shenzhen.
official_line.source: 新浪财经 (Sina Finance), citing MOFA briefing

social_statements.quote_text: The violation of Japan's airspace by Russian aircraft is a serious infringement of Japan's sovereignty.
social_statements.analyst_note: Japan scrambled JASDF fighters after two suspected Russian aircraft entered its airspace off Okinoshima, Fukuoka, on Nov 17, hours ahead of Putin's arrival in Shenzhen.

social_statements.quote_text: Mr President, if you want to appreciate Papua New Guinea's effort in acknowledging the fullest integrity of China in the effort to close Taiwan, it wasn't easy. I faced challenges from within, because we also relate to many nations, but we were resolved.
social_statements.analyst_note: Taiwan closed its representative office in Papua New Guinea earlier this month and halted LNG purchases from the country, citing Chinese pressure.
